title: Maryland Small Estate Affidavit (2026): Small Estate Administration Up to $50,000
rank_math_description: Maryland uses small estate administration, not an affidavit: $50,000 ($100,000 spouse sole heir), one notice, 6-month claims, no Register fee since 2022.
